entries.title: Psalms 105:1
segments: ¶Oh, give thanks to the LORD! Call upon His name; Make known His deeds among the peoples!

entries.title: Psalms 105:2
segments: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him; Talk of all His wondrous works!

entries.title: Psalms 105:3
segments: Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the LORD!

entries.title: Psalms 105:4
segments: Seek the LORD and His strength; Seek His face evermore!

entries.title: Psalms 105:5
segments: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,

entries.title: Psalms 105:6
segments: O seed of Abraham His servant, You children of Jacob, His chosen ones!

entries.title: Psalms 105:7
segments: He [is] the LORD our God; His judgments [are] in all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 105:8
segments: ¶He remembers His covenant forever, The word [which] He commanded, for a thousand generations,

entries.title: Psalms 105:9
segments: [The covenant] which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,

entries.title: Psalms 105:10
segments: And confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel [as] an everlasting covenant,

entries.title: Psalms 105:11
segments: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,"

entries.title: Psalms 105:12
segments: When they were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.

entries.title: Psalms 105:13
segments: When they went from one nation to another, From [one] kingdom to another people,

entries.title: Psalms 105:14
segments: He permitted no one to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,

entries.title: Psalms 105:15
segments: [Saying], "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."

entries.title: Psalms 105:16
segments: Moreover He called for a famine in the land; He destroyed all the provision of bread.

entries.title: Psalms 105:17
segments: He sent a man before them-Joseph-[who] was sold as a slave.

entries.title: Psalms 105:18
segments: They hurt his feet with fetters, He was laid in irons.

entries.title: Psalms 105:19
segments: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the LORD tested him.

entries.title: Psalms 105:20
segments: The king sent and released him, The ruler of the people let him go free.

entries.title: Psalms 105:21
segments: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions,

entries.title: Psalms 105:22
segments: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 105:23
segments: Israel also came into Egypt, And Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:24
segments: He increased His people greatly, And made them stronger than their enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 105:25
segments: ¶He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.

entries.title: Psalms 105:26
segments: He sent Moses His servant, [And] Aaron whom He had chosen.

entries.title: Psalms 105:27
segments: They performed His signs among them, And wonders in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:28
segments: He sent darkness, and made [it] dark; And they did not rebel against His word.

entries.title: Psalms 105:29
segments: He turned their waters into blood, And killed their fish.

entries.title: Psalms 105:30
segments: Their land abounded with frogs, [Even] in the chambers of their kings.

entries.title: Psalms 105:31
segments: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, [And] lice in all their territory.

entries.title: Psalms 105:32
segments: He gave them hail for rain, [And] flaming fire in their land.

entries.title: Psalms 105:33
segments: He struck their vines also, and their fig trees, And splintered the trees of their territory.

entries.title: Psalms 105:34
segments: He spoke, and locusts came, Young locusts without number,

entries.title: Psalms 105:35
segments: And ate up all the vegetation in their land, And devoured the fruit of their ground.

entries.title: Psalms 105:36
segments: He also destroyed all the firstborn in their land, The first of all their strength.

entries.title: Psalms 105:37
segments: He also brought them out with silver and gold, And [there was] none feeble among His tribes.

entries.title: Psalms 105:38
segments: Egypt was glad when they departed, For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:39
segments: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.

entries.title: Psalms 105:40
segments: [The people] asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 105:41
segments: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; It ran in the dry places [like] a river.

entries.title: Psalms 105:42
segments: For He remembered His holy promise, [And] Abraham His servant.

entries.title: Psalms 105:43
segments: He brought out His people with joy, His chosen ones with gladness.

entries.title: Psalms 105:44
segments: He gave them the lands of the Gentiles, And they inherited the labor of the nations,

entries.title: Psalms 105:45
segments: That they might observe His statutes And keep His laws. Praise the LORD!
